package: @astryxdesign/lab

# CommentThread

One conversation: first comment plus replies. For margin cards or highlight popovers. Many threads with a new-comment composer: use Comments.

**Import:** `import {CommentThread} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Anatomy

| Element | Required | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Surface | Yes | An outlined Card on a page, or a Section without outer rules inside a card or popover. A press anywhere on it opens the thread; a visually hidden toggle carries its name and focus. |
| Quoted passage | No | The passage an inline comment discusses, as an italic blockquote ruled in the highlight color, with an Outdated badge once the passage is edited away. |
| First comment | Yes | Avatar, header (name, time, Edited, Resolved, and the actions shown on hover or focus), Markdown body clamped to three lines until the thread opens, and reactions. |
| Replies | No | One level of replies behind View replies, joined to the first comment by an avatar rail while the thread is open. A host-marked unread reply reveals without selecting the thread, moving focus, or opening the reply composer. |
| Live state | No | Controlled typing state follows the conversation while the thread is open, with its pulsing dots in the avatar column and its label on the comment-text line. Controlled `seenBy` metadata remains available to comment render callbacks but has no default presentation. |
| Reply composer | No | A CommentComposer that opens with the thread, beside the viewer’s avatar. |

## Best Practices

- **Do:** In a card or popover: `container="card"`, card padding 0. Thread owns insets, draws no outer rules.
- **Do:** Control `isSelected` when opened from elsewhere (a document highlight). Reveals body and replies without moving focus or opening the composer.
- **Do:** In a Popover over a document: pass `onDismiss`, set `hasLightDismiss={false}` and `hasEscapeDismiss={false}` on the host. Outside press or Escape closes; the first over an unsaved reply/edit shakes and keeps the draft.
- **Do:** Map collaboration state to `typingUsers`/`seenBy`; publish local drafts via `onComposerDraftChange`. `seenBy` hidden unless a render callback shows it. No connections, no participant expiry.
- **Don't:** Stack CommentThreads plus a composer as a discussion. Use Comments.
- **Don't:** Wrap the thread in your own button/link. It is already one toggle.
- **Don't:** Keep host Popover light dismiss on with `onDismiss`. The browser closes it before the thread can keep a draft.

## Accessibility

- **Escape:** With `onDismiss`, Escape dismisses only when no inner layer is open. Picker, menu, or dialog closes first, one per Escape.
- **Unsaved draft warning:** A dismissal over an unsaved reply/edit keeps the thread open, refocuses the draft, and announces politely. Shake is never the only signal.
- **Reduced motion:** No shake under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; focus and announcement remain.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `comment` | `CommentThreadData` | - | The thread: first comment with replies, reactions, optional anchor, transient `typingUsers`, per-comment `seenBy` (not rendered by default). **(required)** |
| `isSelected` | `boolean` | - | Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled. Never moves focus or opens the composer. |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(isSelected: boolean) => void` | - | Viewer opened or closed the thread. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | - | Thread owns its anchored host’s light dismissal: outside press or unhandled Escape calls it. Over an unsaved reply/edit, the first request shakes, refocuses the draft, announces; the next consecutive one dismisses. Typing or pressing inside re-arms. Pair with host `hasLightDismiss={false}` and `hasEscapeDismiss={false}`. |
| `currentUser` | `CommentUser` | - | Viewer: own-comment actions, reply avatar. |
| `mode` | `'interactive' \| 'non-editable' \| 'read-only'` | `'interactive'` | Which actions show, as on Comments. |
| `container` | `'section' \| 'card'` | `'section'` | Parent surface: outlined Card on a page, or rule-less Section in a card/popover. |
| `onSubmit` | `(content: string, parentCommentId?: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Posts a reply; parent is always the first comment. Rejection restores the draft with Retry. |
| `onComposerDraftChange` | `(value: string, context: CommentComposerContext) => void` | - | Reports reply/edit drafts, seeds, and empty values after submit, cancel, or target switch. Route by `context`. |
| `onSaveEdit` | `(commentId: string, content: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Edit to own comments; saves new Markdown. |
| `onDelete` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Delete to own comments, confirmed in a dialog. |
| `onReact` | `(commentId: string, reactionKey: string, option?: CommentReactionOption) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Toggles the viewer’s reaction by stable key. |
| `onRetryComment` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Retry to `status: error` comments. |
| `onResolveThread` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Mark as resolved to an open thread. |
| `onReopenThread` | `(commentId: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | - | Adds Reopen to a resolved thread. |
| `loadVersions` | `(commentId: string) => Promise<readonly CommentVersion[]>` | - | Loads edit history, newest first. |
| `onUploadImages` | `(files: readonly File[], context: CommentComposerContext) => CommentUploadedImage[] \| Promise<CommentUploadedImage[]>` | - | Uploads composer images; appends Markdown images. |
| `isSubmitting` | `boolean` | `false` | Host pending state for the reply composer. |
| `composerPlaceholder` | `string` | - | Reply placeholder. Default: localized "Reply to <name>…". |
| `highlightColor` | `'blue' \| 'cyan' \| 'gray' \| 'green' \| 'orange' \| 'pink' \| 'purple' \| 'red' \| 'teal' \| 'yellow'` | `'yellow'` | Palette color of the passage highlight. |
| `reactionOptions` | `readonly CommentReactionOption[]` | `DEFAULT_COMMENT_REACTIONS` | Reactions Add reaction offers. |
| `agentCommands` | `readonly CommentAgentCommand[]` | - | Agents a reply can address with `/`. |
| `composerTriggers` | `readonly ChatComposerTrigger[]` | - | Reply typeahead triggers, e.g. `@` people search. |
| `markdownPlugins` | `readonly MarkdownPluginEntry[]` | - | Block Markdown plugins for bodies. |
| `markdownInlinePlugins` | `readonly MarkdownInlinePlugin[]` | - | Inline Markdown plugins for bodies, e.g. mentions. |
| `getReplyMention` | `(author: CommentUser) => string \| undefined` | - | Seeds a reply-to-reply with an author mention. |
| `hasEmojiPicker` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the reply composer offers the emoji picker. |
| `renderAnchor` | `(comment: CommentThreadData, defaultAnchor: ReactNode) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces the quoted passage. |
| `renderBody` | `(comment: CommentData) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces a comment’s Markdown body. |
| `renderVersionBody` | `(version: CommentVersion) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces a history version’s body. |
| `renderAdditionalActions` | `(comment: CommentData) => ReactNode` | - | Adds product actions to a comment header. |
| `renderComposer` | `(props: CommentComposerRenderProps) => ReactNode` | - | Replaces the reply input; thread keeps draft and state. |

## Examples

### Margin comment

```tsx
import {Card} from '@astryxdesign/core/Card';
import {CommentThread} from '@astryxdesign/lab';

<Card padding={0} width={320}>
  <CommentThread
    comment={{
      id: 'margin',
      author: {id: 'maya', name: 'Maya Chen'},
      body: 'Should this say three days? The dry run adds one.',
      createdAt: '2026-09-30T19:00:00Z',
      anchor: {quote: 'The final cohort completes rollout in two days.'},
    }}
    currentUser={{id: 'avery', name: 'Avery Kim'}}
    container="card"
    onSubmit={(body, parentId) => postReply(parentId, body)}
  />
</Card>
```

### In a popover that keeps unsaved drafts

```tsx
import {useState} from 'react';
import {Button} from '@astryxdesign/core/Button';
import {Popover} from '@astryxdesign/core/Popover';
import {CommentThread} from '@astryxdesign/lab';

function CommentPopover({thread, viewer}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Popover
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onOpenChange={setIsOpen}
      hasLightDismiss={false}
      hasEscapeDismiss={false}
      label="Comment"
      padding={0}
      width={340}
      content={
        <CommentThread
          comment={thread}
          currentUser={viewer}
          container="card"
          isSelected
          onSubmit={(body, parentId) => postReply(parentId, body)}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        />
      }>
      <Button label="1 comment" variant="secondary" />
    </Popover>
  );
}
```
